ANONYMOUS Finnish and Karelian folk singers. COMPILED AND EDITED by
Elias Lönnrot (1802-1884), whose name is on the title page as
'Koonnut Elias Lönnrot' -- *collected by*. Project Gutenberg records
the author as 'Various' and GITenberg metadata.yaml files Lönnrot
under `contributor: compiler:`, not as author. He is credited here as
EDITOR and nothing more: he did not write these words, and the
provenance route is (3) verified publication year for an anonymous
work as well as (2) the compiler's death.
